items.headline: Drone footage shows scale of wildfire damage in Greek island village
items.description_text: Aerial video of burned homes and olive groves after a wildfire on Evia.
items.body_text:
Drone footage filmed on Tuesday showed burned homes and blackened olive groves around a village on the Greek island of Evia, a day after firefighters brought a wildfire under control.

The fire service said 60 homes had been damaged and that no injuries had been reported.
